about: Images kept in the archive but withdrawn from the Great House Farm (Llandough) collection, gallery, search and sitemap because they show a different place.

items.credit: Stonewood Design & Build on Facebook (Stonewood Design & Build (page album))
items.location: The Barn, Great House Farm, Mamhilad, Monmouthshire
items.reason: Stonewood Design & Build album 'Great House Farm Barn Project': Monmouthshire County Council planning DC/2016/00502 (modifying DC/2015/01186). The photographs show the Monmouthshire & Brecon Canal moorings and a barn conversion in progress; Llandough has no canal and its farm buildings were razed in 1988.
